name: Rocket Lab Corporation
summary: Rocket Lab Corporation, a space company, provides launch services and space systems solutions in the United States, Canada, Japan, and internationally. The company operates through launch services and space systems segments. The company provides launch services, spacecraft design services, spacecraft components, spacecraft manufacturing, optical systems, and other spacecraft and on-orbit management solutions and constellation management services, as well as designs and manufactures small and medium-class rockets and develops flight and ground software. It also designs, manufactures, and sells Electron, an orbital small launch vehicle for small spacecraft launch services, as well as develops Neutron launch vehicles for large constellation deployments, interplanetary missions, and potentially for human spaceflight. In addition, the company designs and manufactures a range of components and subsystems for its launch vehicles and spacecraft. It serves commercial, aerospace prime contractors, and government customers. Rocket Lab Corporation was formerly known as Rocket Lab USA, Inc. and changed its name to Rocket Lab Corporation in August 2021. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Long Beach, California.
leadership_credibility: Legendary aerospace innovator who built Electron into the world's #2 most frequently launched orbital rocket behind SpaceX. Developing medium-lift reusable Neutron rocket.
insider_alignment: Founder Peter Beck holds ~10% equity. Deep engineering leadership with proven orbital track record.
moat_type: Proven Electron Reusable Architecture, Vertically Integrated Space Systems (Reaction Wheels, Solar Panels, Flight Software), National Defense Contracts
moat_durability: Extreme technical barrier to orbit; one of only two commercial Western launch providers capable of frequent orbital insertion.
moat_intangibles: Proven Rutherford 3D-printed rocket engines, carbon-composite airframe manufacturing IP, and flight heritage over 50+ orbital missions.
moat_network_effects: Vertically integrated space systems supplier: satellites built with Rocket Lab solar arrays and reaction wheels create recurring launch loyalty.
moat_pricing_power: Scale & Volume Cost Advantage: Operating margins supported by high-volume throughput and lean unit cost structure (37.3% gross margin).
tam_description: Commercial satellite launch, government constellation deployment, and end-to-end space systems ($120B+ TAM).
tam_sanity_check: Penetration Runway: Rocket Lab's growing backlog ($1B+) reflects expanding share of space systems and dedicated small/medium launch demand.
tam_optionality: Neutron constellation deployment, US Space Force defense payloads, and proprietary commercial satellite constellations.
